notes.title: A Hero's Rest Celebrates the Holidays with Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Town Managers!

The holidays are upon us, and we're bringing gifts to A Hero's Rest! We're thrilled to announce the release of Patch 1.2, packed with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your town-building experience.

But that's not all! From December 22nd to January 5th, 2025, players can unlock unique, limited-time seasonal decorations to deck their towns with festive cheer. And to top it off, A Hero's Rest will be available at a 35% discount during this period, making it the perfect time to embark on your own RPG town-building adventure!

Read on for the full patch notes for Version 1.2:[hr][/hr]
New Features:

Increased Maximum Active Classes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d27224b68730761628e8746c5c348b3e83a76c3c.png
The total number of active classes has been increased to 10 up from 8 when the Training Grounds are built.
This provides greater creative freedom when designing your unique classes.
Improved Production Farms:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/aa04c6a4fd1b255089ba2be3536c6ce884cdaeaa.png

Vendors can now not only restock but also harvest ready Production Farms.
A new "Automatically Harvest & Restock" option has been added to the vendor details panel. Enabling this will make vendors automatically harvest and restock farms.
Vendors will only perform these actions if sufficient gold and resources are available.
Because these actions take time, consider adding more displays or vendor counters to keep customers occupied while vendors are busy.
Holiday Event (December 22nd, 2024 - January 5th, 2025):
Log in during the holiday period to permanently unlock exclusive seasonal decorations for your town!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d18461a4e164f3fcf6eddfb16e0ce9d99142d986.png
[hr][/hr]Changes & Improvements:
The display of lifetime profit in the details menu now supports values in the millions.
Improved the way Template items display the classes that are using them in the inventory.
Optimized pathfinding for heroes within the town.
Improved Loading of Textures for Item Displays.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where heroes would sometimes get stuck sitting.
Resolved a bug that caused incorrect item prices to be displayed in certain shops.
Fixed a rare crash that could occur when rapidly switching between town menus.[hr][/hr]
I hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements. Happy holidays, and happy town building!

Loke

With the release of Patch 1.1, A Hero's Rest takes another step forward. This update introduces new features, essential improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your gameplay experience.

Here are the detailed patch notes:[hr][/hr]Swift Travel:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/9c5cf2884dec557036a83ab77f03c8e95115eb2d.png
A new fast travel option to the Training Grounds has been added for quick and convenient access.
This feature allows players to quickly return to the Training Grounds for class training and upgrades, saving valuable time.
The fast travel option can be accessed through the in-game menu.[hr][/hr]Template Improvements:

Items with templates will now display compatible classes directly in the inventory, making item management easier.
Templates that have unassigned classes, can now be removed directly from the inventory, providing more control over your items.[hr][/hr]Endless Quests:

Medium Stockpiles: Wood cost increased.

I hope you enjoy these new features and improvements!

notes.title: Sneak Peek - 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

Get ready for an epic journey as we are less than 2 weeks away from the full release of A Hero's Rest! To give you a taste of what's to come, we're excited to unveil some of the thrilling new features and improvements included in the upcoming 1.0 patch.

Introducing Standfort Bay
Venture into the uncharted territory of Standfort Bay, a coastal town with four unique entry points and a grand fortress. This new map offers a fresh experience and marks the conclusion of Milestone 4, leading to the full release of A Hero's Rest.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f4b3b7ace4831048edacad334d231893e6a5c3d9.png
While the town may appear sturdy and inviting, don't be fooled by its appearance. The dangers of Felonia lurk around every corner, and you'll need to be vigilant to protect your town.[hr][/hr]
Dynamic Seasons:
Prepare for changing weather conditions that will impact your Heroes from Thunderstorms and blizzards affecting your Heroes' chances of success to stacking resources during Bountiful Summers before facing the Harsh Winter. Dynamic Seasons will bring a new challenge to test your skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/b6168e6438a93189ae295dac02cd2acef284f46a.png
Customize your experience with the varying levels of difficulty, each altering the way Seasons affect your gameplay.
Normal: A balanced gameplay experience with seasonal effects offering both opportunities and challenges.
Hard: A more challenging adventure where the seasons have a greater impact on your town. Seasons will provide significant rewards as well as harsh penalties.
Survival: A demanding test of your survival skills. Each passing year will intensify the seasonal challenges, requiring exceptional resource management and strategic planning.[hr][/hr]
The New Wisdom Attribute:
Expand your tactical options with the introduction of the Wisdom core attribute. These Heroes bring unique abilities focused on support and healing, ensuring your Heroes are ready to undertake any challenge.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/bbc97c501b6d86c493d2326d51b07e96b6767648.png
While their direct damage may be lower than other classes, their support is invaluable. Spells like Mending Hands can restore health and mana to your Heroes, making Wisdom Heroes a formidable addition to your roster.[hr][/hr]
And More!

Weapon Master Specializations: Customize your Heroes' prowess even further with 12 new perks available through the new specialization menu to aid your Heroes' Growth.
Increased Hero Population Cap: Increase the size of your Hero roster up to 120 Heroes! And take your management skills to the next level.
New Combat Animations and Class Badges: Enjoy improved visuals and customize your Heroes' classes with new animations and badges.
Brand New Items: Enhance your shop with 13 new items, including walls, floors, decorations, and a new upgrade.
Improved Building Menu and UI: Experience a more user-friendly interface with enhancements to the building menu and various UI elements.
New Milestones and Objectives: Embark on new challenges and track your progress with additional milestones and objectives.[hr][/hr]
We can't wait to unveil more on release and for you to experience all that A Hero's Rest has to offer in the 1.0 release.

Happy Questing,
Loke & Chaya

notes.title: Patch Notes Version v0.935.27
notes.notes:
Greetings, Champions!

Prepare for our biggest update yet! v0.935.27 brings a wealth of new content and long-awaited features, including the challenging Raid System, a brand new tier of equipment, a revamped itemization system, and a thrilling conclusion to the captivating story of A Hero's Rest. Sharpen your swords, stock up on potions, and get ready to embark on legendary adventures!

Patch Notes Version v0.935.27:

Prepare for Epic Adventures: Raids Arrive!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/3c92d2a8abfe4d97c264262767ec02cf53c36be9.png
New Quest Type: Raids

Face the ultimate test with 6 challenging Raids, each featuring a unique boss, requirements, and legendary rewards.
Assemble your most powerful party of 4 Heroes and meet the Raid's entry criteria to face the challenge.
Utilize Royal Tokens to dispatch your raiding party and conquer the Raid for even greater rewards and subsequent Raids.
Strategize your approach – re-roll Raid difficulty and rewards using Focus Gems for the perfect challenge.
Witness your Heroes embark on their Raid – follow their progress and await their triumphant return (or face the consequences of failure!).
Raids offer the ultimate rewards – legendary loot, powerful Mythical item upgrades, prestigious Medals with unique bonuses, and epic Titles for your Heroes.
Conquer Raids repeatedly to test your might and acquire ever-greater spoils.
Learn more about Raids with the new Compendium pages.
Unveiling Mythical Gear: A New Peak in Power
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/0836f063ec9ca3077e75987590baa1f5168235aa.gif
New Item Rarity: Mythical

Ascend to new heights with Mythical Gear, the pinnacle of equipment for your Heroes.
Acquire Mythical Gear exclusively from conquering Raids – Tier 4, best-in-slot equipment awaits!
Mythical Gear boasts a unique colour scheme and significantly boosts your Heroes' stats.
Similar to Legendary items, Mythical Gear cannot be upgraded with Regrade Stones.
Crafting Mythical Gear through traditional means is extremely unlikely.
Itemization 2.0: A Refined Experience
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/8b84af40a9b13e09cfbac00a950dcffde2ca3efc.png
Items 2.0 & Hero Upgrade Logic Overhaul

We've revamped the entire item system to provide a clearer and more balanced experience.
Items now accurately reflect their worth based on quality – higher quality within the same tier reigns supreme.
Heroes prioritize higher quality items of previous tiers when evaluating potential upgrades, preventing illogical swaps.
Item values across all tiers have been recalibrated to reflect this system. Expect broken and normal items to be less effective compared to higher quality lower-tier items, especially Epics and Legendaries.
Heroes are more likely to keep Legendary gear when considering upgrades.
Once Heroes surpass the 65 CR range, they become less likely to complain about their equipment altogether.
Regrading has been reworked to enhance all item stats instead of adding a single new stat.
A chance for partial upgrades exists – items may receive stat boosts without a quality increase, allowing for further improvement.
New upgrade effects and sounds add a touch of flair to the enhancement process.
One-handed weapons and off-hands have had their stats halved to align with their two-handed counterparts. Shields remain unaffected.
Crafting Convenience: Automatic Crafting
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/7f4cf4992f566805e0fa10eae05adec3d5658a36.png
New Automatic Crafting Slots

Sit back and relax with the new Automatic Crafting system!
The Innkeeper and Apothecary gain crafting slots as their stations level up.
Utilize these slots to automatically craft items as they are purchased, provided you have the necessary materials.
Crafting triggers whenever your stock dips below 15 items, ensuring a well-supplied inventory.
The crafter prioritizes crafting missing items, preventing unnecessary clutter.
Reserved items for specific Heroes are taken into account, ensuring their consumables are restocked.
Embrace Your Core: Enhanced Attributes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/2dd4c210387bcb8cda7fc2276c2d8bfe758178b9.png
Core Attribute Traits

Core attributes now have a greater impact on Hero development.
Each Core Attribute boasts new Traits, adding depth and strategic variety to your Hero roster.
Combine these effects with Gear proficiencies to create truly unique Hero builds.
Mastering team composition will be vital for conquering the new Raids!
A Fitting Conclusion: Achievements & Story
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f42d97924854d8641da36e1d04da210c74ffae64.png
New Achievements & Plot Conclusion

Seven new platform-specific Achievements celebrate your Raid victories.
New events bring the game's story to a conclusion, complete with its own platform-specific Achievement.
Existing story events have been polished for a smoother narrative flow.
Quest Dynamics & More
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/1767baf0a82798b8718ef2ed21ae41c3e776ef8d.png
Quest Changes & Honorable Mentions

New quest dynamics add a fresh layer of strategy to your quest selection.
Slay quests remain the top earner for Hero XP and Gold, propelling your Heroes' growth.
Gather quests offer increased material profit due to a lower listing cost, but come with slightly lower Gold and XP rewards for your Heroes.
A new Threat bar keeps you informed of your proximity to a boss encounter during Slay quests.
Tooltips have been updated to reflect these changes.
The King has grown more patient, offering "Grace Days" when your town's reputation is "At Risk." This allows you time to recover and avoid negative consequences. Check the reputation tooltip for details.[hr][/hr]
Changes & Improvements

Crafters:

Innkeeper and Apothecary base experience per craft has been reduced to 32/64/100 (down from 48/78/100).
Potion Distilleries are no longer unique and no longer provide Debilitating Potions as bonus potions.
Debilitating Potions have been removed due to redundancy and replaced with Lesser and Greater Potions of Fortune, increasing Hero's earned Gold during adventures by 25% and 50% respectively.
Potions of Confidence and Resistance have received new icons due to the addition of the new potions.
Lesser Potion of protection is now a tier 2 Potion up from tier 1.
A new mutator allows you to adjust how many automatic Crafting slots crafters receive upon leveling up.
Pop-ups for station level-up buttons are now larger and more readable.
New Notifications will highlight crafters with unused perks.
Improved visuals for the detail panel.
Quests now display objective icons while browsing your inventory.
Crafting recipes now display icons when browsing your inventory.
The Weapon Master's Class Menu has improved visuals.
Raid Gold rewards contribute to the Innkeeper's profit and Season Summary score.
General:

Buttons for starting or canceling the tutorial in "Letter from Mr. George" have been swapped.
Streamlined and improved tooltips throughout the game for better readability and understanding.
Enhanced UI elements for improved readability and comprehension.
The Hero List Menu now displays CR and current quests for Heroes in the General List.
The Hero Population icon is now a button allowing you to switch between Hero Population and current town population.
Improved aesthetics and performance of the Hero List Menu.
 The Main Menu Logo has been changed.
Gameplay:

Trader's Mystery Box rewards have been increased, and the cost has been reduced. It now features a rare chance for a Jackpot.
Increased the maximum number of Heroes that can appear in town simultaneously at different reputation levels.
Legendary Imminent Threats now provide Royalty Tokens in addition to their original rewards.
Holding down the ALT key (default) displays all Hero name tags. This key can be changed in the keybinds menu.
A new option in the pause menu allows you to toggle the permanent display of Hero name tags.
Name tags now include the Hero's class icon.
Heroes automatically equip titles earned through the Medal reward system. An option to disable this feature is available in the settings menu.
When a Hero levels up, a report appears in the Report Box.
Improved how Heroes choose their food and potions.
The effects of the INT Core Attribute on Royal Tokens have been reduced.
Increased visitor approval gain from fulfilling orders. This effect decays slower as well.
Changes made to previous appearances of Vera Suzuran lore.[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:

Removed a comma from the Core Difficulty Settings tooltip.
Fixed a bug where Hero behaviour in the Hero list wouldn't update while paused.
Fixed a bug where visitors stopped spawning when the maximum number of Heroes in town was reached.
Fixed a bug with the talent that provides a bonus chance to craft Legendary items.
Fixed a bug where respecing a Hero sometimes resulted in higher quality Training Weapons than intended.
Fixed a bug where the Hero Manager wouldn't display the Hero with the lowest CR accurately.
Fixed a bug where Normal (Blue) Threats sometimes penalized the player more than intended.
Fixed a bug during crafting that caused players to receive the wrong amount of items.
Fixed a bug where Heroes weren't receiving extra Gold while questing off-screen.
Fixed a bug where the Trade Route tooltip displayed incorrect information.
Fixed various minor bugs.[hr][/hr]
Happy Questing!

We hope you enjoy this exciting update to A Hero's Rest!

Loke & Chaya

notes.title: Patch Version v0.800.27 A Hero's True Reward Awaits!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Champions!

While our recent relocation to Germany caused a bit of a delay, we apologize for any inconvenience it may have caused. With that said, we've been busy behind the scenes, and this update reflects that dedication. We're thrilled to bring you not just one, but 2 of the key milestones for phase 4 of the roadmap in this update! This patch delivers exciting new features, a revamped difficulty system, and some much-requested improvements to make your heroic journey even more enjoyable. Let's dive in!

A Hero's Rest - Patch Notes v0.800.27: A Hero's True Reward Awaits!

New Features:

Show Your Prowess with Boss Rewards: Conquering fearsome Bosses now grants you more than just bragging rights! Each Boss will award a unique Medal, bestowing your Hero with permanent passive buffs that will solidify their place as a legend in your roster.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/437163b54297c80bff575c1a5414711c80a1a4d4.png
Earn Epic Titles: Flaunt your Heros' accomplishments by displaying the new Title your Heroes earn for defeating each Boss, making your Hero a true force to be reckoned with!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/5a1831b552021879bf6625a04724899006223f1f.png
Craft Your Challenge: Unleash the New Difficulty System! The reins are in your hands! The revamped "New Game" screen allows you to personalize your experience. Select your base difficulty and shape it further with over 15+ Mutators. Want a faster-paced adventure? Amp up the exprience gains! Craving a tactical test? Activate "No Survival chance" for the ultimate challenge! Existing saves remain untouched, with their difficulty settings reflected in the new system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/8acd7918c9017f6e0f08f645a2ca02704a8c11bb.png[hr][/hr]
Changes & Improvements:

Mutator Transparency: Inspect your currently active Mutators with ease! A dedicated menu lets you review their effects while the game is paused.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/4887c85326fe944397c5a0eb1f5465c69c020a32.png
Red Mist Intensifies: The whispers grow louder as you delve deeper into the uncharted territories. The Red Mist's insidious effects intensify with each escalating difficulty, testing the resolve of even the most seasoned explorers. This adds a thrilling layer of challenge for those who crave the ultimate test of courage.
Silence the Grumbling: Hero protests are now part of the ambient soundscape, creating a more immersive experience. You can also finally silence their frustrations completely with a new option in the Settings Menu.
Navigation Made Easy: We've streamlined the Hero Manager for smoother switching between class and Hero management modes. Accessing Hero information feels effortless now.
New Menus, New Possibilities: Dedicated menus have been added to both the Hero List and Hero Sheet, allowing you to effortlessly inspect and equip your Boss-earned Titles.
Compendium Chronicles: All relevant Compendium pages have been updated to reflect the latest changes and additions.[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:

Templates have been fixed: A bug affecting Heroes not purchasing class-specific templates due to skill updates has been resolved. Remember to re-save your templates after this patch to apply the fix.
Trade Routes Back on Track: Trade completion times have been adjusted to their intended value, ensuring a smooth flow of resources.
King's Call Heeded: A bug preventing the King's Requests event from appearing in corrupted saves has been squashed. Your loyalty will always be recognized!
Grass Patch Persists: Rest assured, your carefully landscaped patches will remain untouched across save and load cycles.[hr][/hr]
We hope you enjoy this update! Don't forget to share your feedback and forge your legend in A Hero's Rest!

Happy Questing!

notes.title: Patch Version v0.750.27 Trade Routes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today we're delivering the newest Patch with the final updates for Milestone 3 - introducing Trade Quests, Hero Behaviours, and Hero Retirement.

We're very excited to wrap up another Milestone on the way to 1.0 and we look forward to more things to come in the next Milestone!

Patch Notes Version v0.750.27:

New Features:

Trade Routes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/3223cf8cc0cabe41875f46e170c81fe49e70b679.png
Defeating Bosses across the land made the road safer to allow for new trade routes!
Trade Routes will appear in your Town Ledger after defeating a Boss & having Sam the Trader visit your Town.
Sam The Trader will introduce the Trade Route system on his first visit and will inform you of any new trade route opportunities.
Trade Routes require a small challenge to be completed before they can be set up. Once completed, the Trade Route can be put to use and repurposed at will without the need of completing any further challenges.
To initiate a Trade Route, you will need to choose a Shop and Tier of the Items to trade for. After paying the upkeep cost, the Trade Route will start.
Every time a Trade Route is completed, a random Item of Quality Normal or better, of the Tier of your choice, will be delivered to your shop's Inventory.
You can pause Trade Routes at any time, or rush them to finish them instantly using a Focus Gem (which can be bought at the Trader for Royal Tokens).
Every time an item is delivered a message will appear in the Report Window. If an item fails to be delivered, the reason will be shown in the Trade Route itself.
Trade Routes will continue to deliver Items unless you stop them, can't afford them, or have no stock space. They will automatically resume if all their requirements are met.
Trade Routes can be an excellent tool to keep your shops stocked!

[hr][/hr]
Heroes Quest Behaviour:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/98e33e54f17c413591f18900b3ca20839a1b02fa.png
The Hero's Quest Behaviour dictates how Heroes choose their Quest before going on an Adventure.
There are 4 Behaviours to choose from - Coward, Calculated, Brave & Heroic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/97eb5fec993038a2a1e13cd0eab9ae48cbfbb622.gif
You can switch your Hero's Behaviour by clicking on the new Behaviour Button in the Hero Sheet or through the Hero List.
With the addition of the new Quest Behaviour System, overwhelming Quests had their completion bonus drastically increased!
This new system allows you to send your heroes to take on more powerful Quests for greater rewards!

[hr][/hr]
Hero Retirement:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/3d2866d85f0bdc9f9df8d09347b9696f6c9a7367.png
Heroes may now be retired from your Roster by selecting them in your Town and clicking the "Retire Hero" - Button, that has been added to the Hero Sheet.
Heroes that are retired from adventuring will award you with Regrade Stones based on the Tier and quality of their Gear.
Retiring a Hero will permanently remove them from your Roster.

[hr][/hr]
Changes & Improvements:

The Compendium has been updated to include the new features and changes.
Increased the chance to upgrade a Tier 4 Item using Regrade Stones by 10%.
Reduced the amount of Visitor Requests to make it less spammy.
Increased the likelihood Visitor Requests will require food over Potions.
Doubled the Time given to complete Visitor Requests.
Increased the maximum amount of Resources that can be transmuted at once to 25 per stack.
Tier 4 Materials will now transmute to Tier 3 Regrade Stones instead of Tier 4 to improve game balance with newly added mechanics.
A new and improved Hero Sheet will allow you to access more of your Hero's Information with ease.
Added Tooltips to Items in the Inventory Menu to improve the overall browsing experience.
Added Tier Level Indications to tooltips at the Trader, Recycle Station, and more...
Improved the readability of the Shop's Detail Panel & other UI Elements.

[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug that Item Tooltips would display 1 point more on their main stat. This did not affect CR calculations.
Fixed a bug where the shop's detail panel would sometimes not show the lifetime profit.



Happy Questing!

notes.title: Patch Version v0.620.27 Red Mist
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Sharpen those swords and brew some potions to prepare your Heroes for this next update: Introducing the new Event - Red Mist!

From time to time the mysterious Red Mist will gather and empower some of the fiends of Felonia. Ensure your Heroes are up to the task, because if they succeed, they will return with even greater rewards!



Patch Notes version v0.620.27:

New event - Red Mist:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d3565f30ffc280c16e4ee4efddeed4e98a942da8.pngRed Mist is a new random event that can happen in your town.
During Red Mist some of the land's foes will be empowered, making Heroes undertaking said objectives suffer from a 15%/20%/25% Penalty to Quest Success based on the current difficulty.
The Red Mist effects will affect all questing Heroes as long as the Red Mist is active, even if the quest started before the mist affected the corresponding objectives.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/6e5a462feca01f91e68c235b2d2c3ae05da8331e.png
During Red Mist Heroes that successfully complete their quest will return with 15% more materials rewards than normally. This effect stacks with any further modifiers like Reward Bonus Potions & Challenging+ Quests.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/abecfd056cae3021d3957818c850618e7e014ca9.png
Red Mist lasts for 6 Days and a Notification will inform the player of its start & end.
Quests affected by Red Mist will have a prompt on the various menus. 
[hr][/hr]

Improved Building System:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/02710c1b31f39668ad1b433d36fd0085969add40.gif

Improved building system! Allowing you to re-place walls in a similar fashion to how replacing floors works, making the change of decoration a much more pleasant task.
New Construction options with over 30 new pieces including new variations & a new set of walls, floors & doors for you to decorate your environments.
[hr][/hr]

Changes & Improvements:

New UI Elements were added to highlight Boss & Red Mist Quests.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where a prompt to take photos wouldn't appear in the Town Ledger.
Fixed a bug where the Default hotkey for the town ledger was (Numpad 6) instead of standard (6) (this will not affect existing games)

notes.title: Patch Version v0.560.27 Visitors' Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's time for our next big Update!

This time we're introducing a whole new System to flesh out the regular visitors coming to your Town, new Upgrades, new Furniture, and more!

Get ready to decorate and have fun!



Patch Notes version v0.560.27:

New Features:

Town Ledger

With this Patch, we are introducing a new Menu, the Town Ledger. You can access your Town's Ledger by pressing [6] or clicking the Icon next to your retired Heroes.

Within this Menu, there are multiple things you will be able to accomplish.[hr][/hr]
Visitors' Orders:

Visitors will now request special orders from time to time when they visit the Inn.
Fulfilling Visitors' Orders will increase the Visitors' satisfaction. Higher satisfaction will lead to your visitors leaving Tips when buying Items in your Town.
You can view all available Visitors' Orders and their current satisfaction in the Town Ledger or while crafting at the Innkeeper and the Apothecary.
Orders are optional and will periodically appear in your ledger. They can be a great way to boost the gold income from visitors' purchases.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/71a8bb4bf7062d1e79081629eb8a14469fa22454.png
Expected Visitors:

The Expected Visitors tab will allow you to add your own custom Heroes to appear organically in your town.
You can use the tabs in the menu to assign specific names to your Visitors / Heroes and have your friends and characters from your favourite games join the town as fresh adventuring Heroes.
Names can be removed and switched at any time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/e855f5d5796372c70dcfdff74ab66434a6abd42f.png
Photo Gallery:

Selecting the Photo Gallery will allow you to re-visit your favourite moments in your town.
Whenever you take a picture with the Photo Mode H (default), it will be added to the Photo Gallery.
Pictures in your Photo Gallery will appear in the loading screens and when placing down Framed Paintings in your Town's Shops.
You can expand any picture in the Photo Gallery by clicking on them or permanently delete them by pressing the small X in the top right corner of every thumbnail.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/c74a777908f6ff76f97cae5f17b191ab86a5cd24.png
Compendium:

A New Compendium Page has been dedicated to the Town Ledger.[hr][/hr]
New Furniture:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d34f1335ddef292642e39fc4549d5e17799e143e.png
A range of new items have been added to the game:

You can find over a dozen new Furniture Items in all building categories including sofas, counters & shop signs.
A total of 6 new Shops for your visitors in the upgrades tab provide new services for your visitors.
A new grass patch can be used to place grass around your shops.
A new Category has been added to the build menu "Decorations" to improve the menu's navigation.[hr][/hr]
New Station Upgrades:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/0052ae1d2cf0bfb139414c8d38377245e3718bed.gif
Each workstation can now be upgraded with a new set of Shops for Visitors.

The Innkeeper can now be upgraded with a Cartographer. 
You can restock it with Tier 2 Wood to sell Maps to your Visitors and make sure they (hopefully) never lose their way.
The Apothecary can now be upgraded with a Dried Herb Rack. 
You can restock it with Tier 2 Herbs to sell some dried spices for your Visitors' home cooking.
The Blacksmith can now be upgraded with a Potshop. 
You can restock it with Tier 2 Metal to supply your visitors' kitchens with knives, pots, pans, and more!
The Woodworker can now be upgraded with a Furniture Stand. 
You can restock it with Tier 2 Wood to provide your Visitors' with some basic furniture to take home.
The Tanner can now be upgraded with a Leather Goods Shop. 
You can restock it with Tier 2 Leather to make sure your Visitors return home with a new pair of boots and dry feet.
The Tailor can now be upgraded with a Clothing Shop. 
You can restock it with Tier 2 Cloth and fulfill your visitors' wishes for some new fashionable clothes to take home.[hr][/hr]
Changes:

The Music Button has been moved to the top left Corner Menu, and its functionality has been left unchanged.
A New button has been added to the Recipe Crafting Menu to open the Ledger's Visitors' Orders.
All Original Shop Stands had their Class Requirements reduced to 1 down from 2 to match those of the Beehive.
Blacksmith's Tools Shop is now an exterior shop stand.[hr][/hr]

Fixes & Improvements:

Fixed a Bug that happened when moving objects and the control's tooltip wouldn't show.
Fixed an issue causing Daily Quests limit to sometimes become minus.
Improved the Visuals of Effects in Various Items.
Cecil will now introduce the new Order System.
Added an Option to Disable the Lightning Flashes during Thunderstorms in the Graphic Options.[hr][/hr]

Known Issues:

Fruit Juice crafted before this patch, will count for Visitors' Orders requesting apples. This will not occur with Fruit juice crafted after this patch.
 Existing versions of the game might need the Town's Ledger Hotkey to be manually assigned in the setting menu.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.520.27 Workstation Upgrades Part II
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

With this new Patch we're bringing you the first additions of our third milestone: More Workstation Upgrades! 

Break down unwanted Items into their Materials, gather Tier 2 Resources on the Map and brew some fresh beer to make your Town even more successful.

We still have a lot of things planned before the Full Release of the game!

We hope you enjoy the new Update and we look forward to more things to come. 


Patch Notes version v0.520.27:

New Upgrades:

Recycle Station:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/8a4fd2cbb94d6fe82193e25e4c73cbd71e5b9633.png

The Recycle Station is a new upgrade that can be placed at the Training Grounds to Recycle Unwanted gear into resources.
You can Filter the items showing at the station by Shops, Item categories, Gear quality & Tier.
Every Item has a chance to return some of the resources that were used when crafting it, the item will be lost in this process.
You can select multiple items to recycle at once.
A New Compendium Page has been added for this station.
This is a Unique Upgrade and therefore only one can be built.
[hr][/hr]
Beer Keg:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/9a7e7c7a3a54dd88a10c0a8a6f3e8da4a9bd088d.png

The Innkeeper has been working hard to bring a Beer Keg to always have a fresh Tankard of homebrewed goodness prepared for its customers.
The Beer Keg will periodically generate Beer for you, which you can collect by clicking on the Beer Keg.
To ensure you have the best Beer in Felonia, you will need a large amount of High-Quality Materials to add this boon to your Inn.
[hr][/hr]
Iron Mine:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/4b3d4e56227680671369767f9b664dfa25b6df0f.png

Your blacksmith dug deep to study the land and uncover hidden Ores, which allows you sometimes to find higher-quality metal from Ore deposits.
Once built you will have a 25% chance to find Iron (T2 Metal) from the Natural Ore deposits scattered around the map.
New Workstation Perk: Miner's Diary - increases the effects of the Iron Mine by an extra 15%.
This is a Unique Upgrade and therefore only one can be built.
[hr][/hr]
Saw Station:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f16dc6028bdb4fb9977c4547c526fe54464e41a2.png

The Saw Station allows your Woodworker to unlock their hidden potential and sometimes gain higher Quality Wood from Trees.
Once built you will have a 25% chance to find Yew (T2 Wood) from some Trees scattered around the map.
New Workstation Perk: Reforestation - increases the effects of the Saw Station by an extra 15%.
This is a Unique Upgrade and therefore only one can be built.
[hr][/hr]

Changes:

The amount of potions crafted to get the free potion from the Potion Distillery has been reduced by 50%
When Creating a new Template, the Template will now inherit the current name of the Item that is being saved.
When Crafting a Template, the Template's name will now replace the current item's name. You may still randomize each craft's name in the same manner that you would randomize any other item's name.
The Blacksmith's Crystalized Dragon Essence Perk has been replaced with Miner's Diary.
The Woodworker's Crystalized Dragon Essence Perk has been replaced with Reforestation.
The Blacksmith's and Woodworker's Perks have been reset in line with the new perks' arrival.
New Icons have been added to the building tooltips to hint at whether the Item can be built Outdoors or Indoors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d39650e69a8f487c70cc7435e2c7fbb49706b480.png
[hr][/hr]

Fixes & Improvements:

Fixed a Bug where the notice board would generate more daily quests than intended.


Happy Building!

notes.title: Patch Version v0.450.27 Crafting Templates
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're happy to wrap up our second Milestone on the Road to Release with this new Patch!
There are still lots of things to come, and we're excited to continue on this journey.

We prepared a video with the highlights of this month, and hope that you all enjoy the new Features
Happy crafting!

[previewyoutube=5dOAl-sxwHI;full][/previewyoutube]
Patch Notes version v0.450.27:

New Features:

Crafting Templates:

It is now possible to save your favourite gear designs as Templates in the Crafting Menu
Templates will allow you to quickly access different designs you made and assign them to specific active Classes to improve the overall dress code of your town.
You can have up to 8 Templates per item type which can be distinguished by different Badges, for more than 100+ Templates in total.
To Craft a Template select one of your Templates from the flags on the left side of the Crafting Menu, and click the craft arrow as you would with any other item.
Templates can only be equipped by the classes selected, Heroes whose class is not assigned to the template will not consider those items as valid purchasable options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a2c6d3b4dc09657b5446668b190a746605daac6c.png
Once a Template is saved, its appearance can't be changed, but you can further modify the template's settings at will.
Classes may have multiple Templates assigned to them.
Template items will have a distinguished Template Logo appear in all the Inventory windows.
Deleting a Template will cause all crafted items still in the Inventory crafted from that Template to reset and no longer have any Template associated with them.
A New Compendium Page has been dedicated to Template Crafting.
[hr][/hr]
Changes:

A New Filter has been added to the Tailor's "Extras" inventory to filter between Foci and other accessories, in the same fashion items are filtered for the other shops.
Heroes that die in combat while on a quest, will now have the quest's name displayed in the retired screen.
The Compendium Entry about Heroes' needs has been updated to include the changes added with the Template System.
[hr][/hr]
Fixes & Improvements:

Improved Vendors' AI & Pathing to restock production farms allowing them to restock in more complex scenarios.
Fixed a crash that would happen when trying to customize T4 Heavy Armour.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.440.27 Workstation Upgrades Part I
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today arrives the newest Patch to a Hero's Rest, introducing a whole new Compendium giving you detailed information about the game's systems, and on top of that, a bunch of new Upgrades to give advantages to your Workshops. This is only Part I of the Workstation Upgrades, so there will be even more in the upcoming Patches.

We hope you enjoy, build, and take good care of your Heroes!

Patch Notes version v0.440.27:

New Upgrades:

Potion Distillery:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/00ae4e3b15a8e25e15a9a1ddc4eb9cbccce3901c.png

This new Upgrade can be placed at the Apothecary and will use scraps from your regular Potion crafting to periodically produce a random Potion of any Tier.
The Potion Crafted will not exceed the crafter's tier level.
Banner of Arms:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a8e9dd00d720f6f64abaa27c9486ed0746ac85c4.png

Place the Banner of Arms at your Training Grounds to inspire your Heroes and increase the experience they gain while training.
Heroes under the influence of the Banner will receive a 25% Experience bonus and it will stack with other bonuses gained from Potions or Legendary Items.
Effects gained from overlapping Banners will not stack.

Noticeboard:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/e8027830de9b99011a0d136797ab7df097145dd9.png

Place the Noticeboard at your Inn to inform your Heroes of their Tasks and increase your Daily Quest Limit.
If the Noticeboard is removed while Daily Quests are assigned with the bonus quests it grants, the latest Daily Quests will be reverted to regular Quests.

Spinning Frame:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/637fd1a775f496b8c225f51acf00009fe082ec9a.png

Enhance the quality of the cloth you produce by upgrading your Tailor with this state-of-the-art Spinning Frame, allowing your Farms to sometimes generate Tier 2 Cloth.
Once the spinning frame is placed in the shop, it will provide a passive 20% chance to receive Tier 2 Cloth from the shop's production farms.

Leather Soaking Tub:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f252f9428727959b55ef0b09d118e92f7b7008e4.png

Add an extra Step to your Leather processing and sometimes generate Tier 2 Leather from your Rabbit Traps.
Once the Leather Soaking Tub is placed in the shop, it will provide a passive 20% chance to receive Tier 2 Leather from the shop's production farms.

Compost:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/92b8b3b9d2cd4f6297cf5ad458cc680e1f5c7ea5.png

Create a sustainable supply of fertilizer for your Herb Gardens to increase their Quality and sometimes generate Tier 2 Herbs.
Once the Compost is placed in the shop, it will provide a passive 20% chance to receive Tier 2 Herbs from the shop's production farms.
[hr][/hr]
New Features:

Compendium:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f5678df1c3fe885a91f02c646c66c417e131265c.png

 The Compendium is a new tool to access detailed information about the different systems in the game.
 The Compendium can be accessed at any time from the new side menu and while performing any action in the game.
 With over 20 pages you can find information on Crafting, Inventory management and more.
General:

A New menu has been added to the top left of the screen to allow the player to access the "ESC Menu" & the Compendium
[hr][/hr]
Changes:

The Experience Icon Floating over the Heroes when they receive XP from training has been changed.
The Feedback Envelop that was in the left corner of the screen has been removed & replaced by the new Menu.
[hr][/hr]

Fixed some spelling mistakes, particularly regarding Hero's Thoughts.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.410.27 Vendor Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just in time with the Steam Spring Sale, we bring you our latest Milestone Patch: The Vendor Overhaul!

Each Vendor now has their own specialization tree with many different bonuses for you to choose from and, on top of that, will now be able to assist you in managing your resource farms.

We hope you enjoy the new Update!

Patch Notes version v0.410.27:

New Features:
Station Specialization:

Vendors have been completely overhauled and now feature the station specialization system which can be accessed from their detail's menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f0161acacb500389f68ade0f6ec7dbf3a996dd5c.png
By clicking on the Vendor you will now be able to open the Details menu and choose from over 50 perks spread across all the crafting stations, which will allow you to focus your stations on doing what you want them to, in the most effective way possible.
As Workstations level up their progression is measured in their detail's panel. As this increases, they will be able to unlock up to 4 tiers of perks that you can set your station to specialize on.
Mr George will introduce the player to the new system once it becomes relevant in their game.

New Resource - Focus Gem:

Once the Specialization is chosen, the option is locked and if you wish to change the station specialization you will need to buy a Focus Gem from the Trader the next time he is in town. But be mindful that as this gem is scarce & his stock is limited.
Using a Focus Gem to Reset your station specialization will reset all of its current selected options.
Focus Gems can be purchased for 10 Royal Tokens across all difficulties.

Production Farms Restocking:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/4371ddafc9797ade66f8fd1a04263eeab2000bd2.png

For a small fee, you will now be able to send your vendor to restock your production farms through the Detail's Panel
Restocking fee varies on the Game Difficulty, and the vendor will be unavailable to serve your customers while taking the task. Making sure you have Shop Displays available, will ensure that customers stay entertained during this time.
Before Sending the Vendor to Restock the farms a tooltip will display the estimated price for the restocking, if the vendor fails to restock any of the farms you will receive a notification for a reason & no cost will be deducted from the player. [hr][/hr]
Changes:

The Daily Hero attribute bonus report will now include bonuses earned by the station specialization perks. 
The Vendor Detail Panel now Features the Station Specialization Perks & The ability to send your vendor to restock production farms. [hr][/hr]
Fixes & Improvements:

Fixed a bug where the Trader would not load after loading a save where the trader was in town during the save.


Happy Questing!

notes.title: Patch Version v0.400.27 Active Pause
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As always we are keen on your feedback and doing our best to implement your ideas to fit our vision for the game. Today we are releasing the latest patch for A Hero's Rest, including some of the most requested features to date.

To make it easier we put together a patch-highlight video, for those who prefer to get the news in that format.

[previewyoutube=tdM_4mIsOBQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
As always, below, Patch notes for Version v0.400.27:

New Features:

Active Pause:

This highly requested feature, will allow you to pause the game and take the time you need to craft, build, manage your inventory and more.
Active Pause can be accessed by clicking the pause icon in the Speed controls or by pressing the slow speed hotkey [1] twice.
Some upgrades & actions that require time to pass will not be available during pause.
Active pause can be used in all difficulties.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/e2ec88158cd0a1ed973757f67c633e584deb546c.gif[hr][/hr]
Daily Quests: 

Quests can now be set as daily from the inventory menu. This will allow you to set a specific number of quests to be repeatable and automatically post them once they are taken by Heroes. 
The Standard posting fee applies when posting a quest in this manner. If you don't have the resources to re-post that quest, the quest will be removed by the Hero taking it and you will receive a Warning Notification of what quest failed to re-post.
Daily quests are limited and are unlocked by defeating new Bosses that threaten your Town for a total of 10 Daily Quests, with an additional 2 quests given for reaching Barren Reputation in Relaxing difficulty.
A counter in the Inventory window will show how many Daily Quests you have still available.
With the introduction of Daily Quests, the maximum quest limit has been decreased to 5/8/12/18/30 down from 5/10/14/20/99 from Deserted to Glamorus respectively.
Daily Quests can also be set as High Priority or Reserved to a specific Hero in the same fashion that normal quests can.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/ef5a9f20984b8a2147f1575a894b28048f55c6cd.png[hr][/hr]
Hero Retention:

When the Hero's Morale is depleted, they will now protest in front of the innkeeper for a day's length, during this time you will have the opportunity to pay off the hero and convince them to stay at the price of 500/1000/1500 gold per Hero Level based on the current difficulty.
Selecting a protesting Hero will prompt a pop-up in the Hero Sheet, that will allow you to pay the Hero's Demanded sum, or release them from your roster immediately.
Heroes that are compensated, will continue their business as usual and finish their shopping routine. They will also have their morale restored to Neutral (50%). 
If the Hero protesting is in your favourites list, a notification will inform you that he is considering retiring.
Heroes that are not paid off in time, will permanently retire from your Hero roster.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/ea941c3b29a351bb95c7e0573487dc1ad121a722.png[hr][/hr]
New Proficiency: Focus
introducing a new set of Items for your Heroes - Magic Focus! Equip your heroes with everything they need to succeed in their journey, with 32 new customizable foci that can be crafted at the Tailor.
The Foci are the ideal item to boost your Heroes' Intelligence and bring a mystic appeal to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d6c504aaa6de36e1c92040af05ceeb878afd4e20.gif
[hr][/hr]
Changes:

When checking classes in the Class Manager, it will now display the number of Heroes currently recruited for each class.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/12d8bd0206fc89d1d690b48d9ed056413c2a344c.png
When Hovering over the fast travel buttons to check the Vendor's Stock, it will now show the stock in detail for the separated categories at a glance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a7fb54a16cb17996d07db50fa8a1564e69ec88dd.png[hr][/hr]
Fixes & Improvements:

Improved the tracking of the Trader & weapon Master through gameplay sessions, reducing the spawn time of either, especially during the period of short sessions
Fixed a bug where in some maps teleporting to the Traveller's camp would cause the camera to fall through the ground.
Replaced the "Town" Icon in the objectives tracker to represent the new Standard Reputation icon.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.304.27 Difficulty Re-Balance
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.

We are happy to bring our newest patch for the game, introducing a lot of balancing changes & improvements with a focus to increase challenge & flow, especially in the Challenging & Hardcore Difficulties. 

The goal was to keep the relaxing difficulty relaxing for those who enjoy the building aspects of the game. While improving the challenge and replayability of the harder difficulties while also improving their pace.

Patch Highlights:

New Prosperity System.
Improved Resource Gain.
Improved Threat System.
Crafting Recipies changes.
New Stockpiles, Features & Improvements.

Later this month, we will be bringing another patch with a lot of new & requested features that we teased in our January Dev Log last week. 

Happy week everyone! 

Loke & Chaya 🤓
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr]Below, Patch notes for Version v0.304.27:


Difficulty Changes:

New:

Resources needed for crafting at the workstations, have been normalized across all difficulties.
Overwhelming Quests will now provide extra rewards in the same fashion Challenging Quests do.
When "At Risk" prosperity or worse, a tax penalty of 10%/20%/35% is applied by the king based on the current game difficulty. The Penalty can be seen in the new reputation tooltip. (see below)
Changes:

Slightly Improved resource gain from quests, especially for Hardcore Difficulty.
Increased resource gain from natural resources in all the difficulties.
[hr][/hr]
Reputation Changes:

New:

Town Prosperity - The Current Lose Condition has been replaced by this feature. In addition to Reputation, Prosperity plays a major role in the success of your town. Losing your Prosperity could lead to game over.

There are 3 stages of Prosperity to look out for:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/80326bbb30f38469b2088274873e3d672dcd3c6b.png Good - By keeping a Positive Balance & good King's Approval, Your Town is safe and thriving
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/ec0c7891faf0dce4b60508d8a93bbb67684dadde.png At Risk - Your actions have caught the attention of the king and a negative balance could lead to Bad Prosperity.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d59ada04835321931d5a1c11f43a4758da7ae1dd.png Bad - At this stage, you are given until midnight to improve your current balance or you will lose the game. (The Game Over screen has been left unchanged. This means you can continue your playthrough but Platform specific achievements will no longer be unlocked.)
*We will continue to expand on this feature as we implement new systems into the game.

Changes:

Reputation Penality during evaluation, for going into Negative Balance, has been reduced to a third of its current value to a max of -20 Reputation points.
Refusing a King's Request will have its reputation & prosperity effects take place immediately and will set your town into "At Risk" Prosperity. These effects will last 1-4 days.
Having a Negative evaluated balance will put your town into "At Risk" Prosperity, this can be amended by having a positive balance by your next evaluation.

Reputation ToolTip:

The Reputation Breakdown Tooltip has been reworked to include your current Reputation (Deserted, Barren, etc....) and your prosperity. It will now also appear when hovering over your Reputation Stars.
The Current Fame Tooltip Has been Removed & Replaced by the Reputation Breakdown.
Increased the Size of the Reputation Breakdown UI for better readability.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/56ab87dc50ed2fcb4cbebb9b2c6269a627d66d36.png[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Patch Version v0.300.27 QOL Part II
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. 

We are happy to bring our newest update - Quality of Life Part II. In this update, we took on several aspects of the game that needed some polishing and we did everything in our power to improve the gameplay experience. 

Also as announced last week, we are opening our beta branch. For details on how to access it, check the bottom of this announcement.

Looking forward we will be posting our Roadmap in the next few days to give you all a glance at our plans for the future of "A Hero's Rest" 

Without further ado, Patch notes for Version v0.300.27

Difficulty Changes:

Games that have received the Game-Over Screen and continued will no longer be able to receive Steam Achievements during that playthrough. Milestones will continue to unlock normally but achievements will not be rewarded for gaining them. This is to reward players that haven't lost the game during their playthrough. This will affect new & existing games, achievements that have already been earned this way will not be changed.
When playing in Relaxing difficulty Heroes will now consider leaving the town once their Morale is below 20%, down from the previous 40%, gradually increasing the chance as it reaches 0%. This is not Retroactive and will only affect games created after this patch.

Accessibility:

Added Keybinds for Rotating the camera with the Keyboard, these can be changed in the
Control section of the Settings menu.
The Zoom in / Out with the keyboard has been reworked and will now work properly.
Added a New Slider to the control section of the settings menu to adjust the speed in 
which you zoom in / out when using your zoom, This affects both keyboard & Mouse Zoom.

New:

The Message log has been reworked, Now you are able to filter what's displayed in the log
by Consumables / Gear / Quests and Other (Like Restocks or Bee-Hive Sales) notifications.
The Message Log can now be resized by dragging the new button on the right corner of the log.
The left button can still be used to instantly collapse or expand the log.
Quests will now automatically generate a name based on the quest's context.
Gear Items can now be renamed after crafting by selecting them via the inventory menu.
New options at the trader now allow you to sell all broken / Bad Items in your shops
and also give you the ability to buy/sell Materials in Bulk of 1/5/10. Remember that when
buying / selling in bulk you are still subject to the supply & demand rate changes.
Mousing over the Hero Helmet next to your hero count UI to show the tooltip, will now
also show the current town population, formed by Heroes & Visitors.
Crafting menus will now display the current stock of products belonging to the shop. It's now
possible to quickly open the inventory corresponding to the shop by pressing the button next to the stock.

Changes:

Heroes' upgrading logic has been improved. They will now be smarter about upgrading, increasing
their effectiveness while reducing situations where they would get morale penalties.
When Checking a Hero's inventory it will now be possible to see the current Item Tier represented
at the bottom of the tooltip.
Crafters will now improve their crafting skills of lower tier items as they level up, the better the crafter, the higher the chances they will craft a quality item for all Tiers.
Rare Items should now be easier to distinguish in the Hero Inventory.
Hovering over the Heroes CR-Ranges in the top left of the Hero Manager will now display the number of Heroes currently displayed in the list.
The Visitors are back! Visitors will flock to your town more regularly as your population increases. Previously visitors became scarce as your hero population increased, this is now changed and they will make sure to return for those shop stands in your shops!
While in Popular reputation, Quest limit has been increased to 20 up from 15
We reworked the wording of the threats when you mouse over the images, to make them more engaging and explanatory of your objectives.
The Icon displaying Decorations in the Details panel of the vendors has been replaced.
Rephrased the QuestBoard's Tooltip to better guide new players on how to place it down. 

Fixes & Improvements:

Increased the text size in the quest name for better readability.
The Season summary will now properly reward players that have reached the soft cap of 50 Hereos and have not lost or gained Heroes during the season in review.
The inventory Window will now be more responsive when switching categories or vendors, This is especially noticeable when owning a large number of inventory items.
When switching between quest objectives, custom Quest names will no longer reset once chosen.
Fixed a bug where Item Images were missing their images in the inventory window when loading a cloud save into a different computer or System.
Fixed a bug that would occur under certain conditions, that would lock players from opening windows or exiting the game. (We will continue to investigate this but we believe we covered the cause of the bug if this happens during your play you can QuickSave [F5 by default] and QuickLoad [F9 by default].)
A Bug that allowed players to make some profit from the Trader in Hardcore Difficulty has been fixed. This is no longer possible to replicate.
Fixed a bug where very unfortunate heroes would find themselves lost in thought at the entrance of the town, never to continue their Heroic journeys.
Fixed an issue where the Weapon master wouldn't move back to his station's location if the Station
Was only moved slightly off from its original location. 

[hr][/hr]
Playing on the  Beta Branch: 

While this branch will grant access to new content there are a few things that are important to mention, and it's very important that you Backup Your Save before ever playing in this branch.

The Beta Branch will receive frequent updates while a big update is in the works for the main branch of the game.
The Beta Branch is unstable and it may have more bugs / and possible game-breaking problems while the content is in production, Save Games may be corrupted and lost, it's important to Backup Your saves before playing in this branch.
The Beta Branch will allow us to test features earlier and with greater feedback than we could possibly accomplish in-house, allowing us to provide better and bug-free updates.
The Content in the Beta Branch is a work in progress and always subject to change, It's advised to not take the features released there as set in stone.
The Beta Branch will only be used for bigger updates. Some smaller ones will be pushed to the main branch without a testing period in the beta branch as long as we know it's safe to do so.  

The Main Branch is and will always be the most stable and up-to-date version to play the game, and the only official version supported.

Accessing the Beta Branch:

In Order to play on the beta branch all you need to do is the following steps.

Open the context menu by Right clicking "A Hero's Rest" in your library and go to properties.
Go to Betas and Select "Beta - Unstable Build"
You are ready to go, steam should download the beta version of the game and give You access to the build currently active. 

At the time of this release, the beta branch and the main branch will be identical but this may change in the future when we work or larger patches.

 This is complemented by the addition of Tier Filtering that was added so you may also Filter your items by Tier, allowing you to better plan for your next craft.

New buttons allow you to filter by Class or sort your Heroes by their current Status to keep track of what they are going to do next. 
You can also use this to filter out and track your favorite Heroes.
 The Hero Manager now shows the minimum and maximum CR of Heroes listed.



Changes:

 When Heroes fail to find a quest for their current CR, it will now display the name of the hero & the CR required in the notification.
 Chairs will now be able to be placed freely without the need for a table, even when using Snap to Grid Mode. There's no more need to puzzle objects around at the innkeeper.
 Trees have had their required space reduced to allow more freedom of customization of the building lots.
 Heroes that retire will now show their CR in the retired Heroes menu. This only applies to Heroes that retire after the introduction of this patch.
 If you haven't created a class the weapon master will send a notification to remind you of this.
 The Royal Request button has been moved on top of the objectives focus missions and objectives in one place.
 Mousing over the current Date & Time will now also display the current year in the tooltip.



Fixes & Improvements:

 Quick Saving & Loading will be disabled while saving is in progress, this is to avoid corrupted Save games.
 When crafting different rarities of items the shop will now properly reward the station with more experience.
 Fixed a bug where objectives were missing. The player now has all the corresponding objectives displayed to him properly.
 Fixed a bug when trying to transfer a training device across building lots, which would cause it to get destroyed and lock its previous lot from allowing a new one.
 Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances the Heroes would not sleep at the Training Grounds.
 Fixed not being able to click through the white tooltip messages.
 Fixed a bug that was causing heroes with legendary gear to have duplicates of their gear bonus.
Furthermore, Heroes were stacking identical bonuses within their gear - for balancing reasons, this was never intended to be the case.
 Fixed Legendary descriptions to properly describe their bonus effect.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.298.27 Fixes & Improvements.
notes.notes:

Items at the Trader's Market Menu will now display their corresponding
Tier Levels.
Added Tooltips to explain the sort function in the Trader's Market Menu.
Reserved Quests Drop Down Menu Will now display the Hero's CR
The font used in these menus has also been changed to improve readability.
Improved the Trader's Menu Visibility for UltraWide Screens.

Guest Beds can now be placed in Training Grounds, allowing you to set up
Some barracks for your restless Heroes. - The Profit gained from these beds

Improved the AI of Heroes when attempting to reach the Innkeeper, drastically
reducing notifications of the Innkeeper being busy.
Changed the image appearance of the Greater Potion of Wisdom & Potion of Knowledge
to better match the colour scheme of the potion's effects.

scheme of the potion's effects.

Slay to Gather quests.
Fixed Cursor jumping around wildly when renaming items & Heroes in UltraWide Screens.

causing the game to lock players and forcing them to restart.
Fixed a bug which caused Heroes wearing capes to drop them under the table while they

This would cause the bed to get stuck and kept the player from being able to delete it.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.293.27 Release + Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

The Demo is out and it has been a blast! plenty of feedback has been sent our way and we are working hard on making sure everyone has the best experience with the game.
Below are the patch notes for version v0.293.27.

A Hero's Rest Patch v0.293.27 Patch-notes.

New:

We made some quality-of-life improvements to the Quest Crafting Menu. Now a new interface will show how many heroes you have that will be able to take on the quest you are planning to craft, and how many are below or above the quest difficulty. 

This will make it easy to spot your overall CR Ranges and better plan for quests with less need for other menus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/8dd29cf3cfeba589a47af6593b6d45d9ad1e5521.png

Changes:

Notifications will now disband automatically after more than 8 notifications are left unchecked, if the notification contained any kind of resources or events, they will automatically activate on dismiss.
By default, Notifications can now be dismissed instantly by clicking on them, the option to hold the mouse button to dismiss can be set in the options menu while in-game. (This will not change the current setting in previous saves, if you would like to change it to the new mode, you can do it in the options menu while in-game).
New Heroes that arrive in town will now instantly be added to the hero list instead of showing after they depart for the first time. And a notification will pop in the icon to alert you that you have a brand new hero waiting for you.


Fixes & Improvements:

Improved pathfinding among heroes and visitors, will primarily improve the navigation around small buildings and tight spaces.
Fixed a bug that was happening when pausing the game while crafting a class where you could pick proficiencies that you couldn't afford which caused confusion before finishing crafting said class.
Fixed a bug where in a scarce situation the innkeeper may get stuck and heroes would not be able to process their demands with him.


Hotfix:

Fixed a bug where sometimes floors wouldn't properly align during building.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.292.27 Release
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

Based on the recent feedback that we gathered from early adopters of the game, we made some adjustments to improve the overall experience!

A Hero's Rest Patch 292.27 Patch-notes.

 Improved descriptions across some items for an improved player experience.
 Removed directional arrows from items that were not affected by directional placement.

Hero Classes:

Bug Fixes: 


 Fixed a bug that was causing the class options to be disabled under specific circumstances.
 Fixed a bug where sometimes you would need to craft a second Oven if the Innkeeper was destroyed.

notes.title: A Hero's Rest Version 0.291.27 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Adjusted happiness penalty to scale with Town Reputation 
 

We noticed from the feedback we got that the morale penalty Heroes receive for not being able to find a quest with an appropriate CR range, not being able to buy items, or not being able to buy food in the early game is too punishing, so it can be hard to accumulate resources. We adjusted it so the penalty will be lower in the early game and scale up with higher Town Reputation.

notes.title: Dev-Update July '22
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've been working hard to get "A Hero's Rest" ready for Early Access and want to give you a quick look at what we've been working on!

In "A Hero's Rest" you get tons of options to customize the gear you craft for your Heroes.
For example: Pauldrons!

Every proper Hero needs some shoulder protection of course, so I've been working on adding a range of different Pauldrons to the game.

Whenever I work on pieces of Armour for the Heroes, I like to start off by creating a High-Poly Model with lots of Detail. Here for example are three sets that we've already added to the game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a01d7781f2e0b03247c3f3c3f2a09d339e01d863.gif

Once I'm happy with these Models, I create a clean, simple Mesh to texture.

After I've transferred all the Details from the High-Poly Model and finished the Textures, we can add the new Meshes to the game, ready to be customized and crafted for your Heroes :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/8cd8478f978156b5a1e0c9c51d5be70f66795c09.gif

Chaya :)
